name: Suzhou Wanxiang Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Wanxiang Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of precision components in China and internationally. It offers thermal protection, digital transmission and control integrated, precision structural, flexible functional, and power/energy storage battery structural components, as well as miniature lithium-ion batteries and CCS integrated drain. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
